values.task_boundary: Build one complete release-tail census and gap-analysis packet, then emit one fail-closed admission decision.
deliverables: Findings-first gap analysis in Markdown and JSON
Exact issue, PR, revision, ancestry, artifact, and owner denominator
Updated demo matrix only where observed evidence requires correction
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every planned v0.92.1 issue and retained predecessor dependency is enumerated with no silent omission
AC-2: Every required lane is reviewed, merged, ancestral, and indexed by exact revision and artifact
AC-3: Acceptance criteria and execution specifications are compared with real production implementation and execution evidence
AC-4: Test-only, placeholder, unused, partially wired, do-nothing, or unexecuted implementations are identified and cannot pass admission
AC-5: Missing validation, stale review, documentation drift, collision, and closeout overclaim findings carry severity, evidence, uncertainty, disposition, and owner
AC-6: Gap results are classified as release blockers, durable proof gaps, routed work, stale readiness documentation, or non-blocking quality concerns
AC-7: No unresolved P0/P1 gap or unowned material gap remains in an admitted candidate
AC-8: Machine-readable and human-readable gap reports and the admission record agree on denominator, revisions, findings, and decision
non_goals: Perform live cloud or runtime mutations
